title: 📊 SPN-123 Complete operation and sync diagnostic coverage
body:
## 📊 Complete production operation and sync diagnostics

Production diagnostics now observe actual document readiness, local persistence, validated server acknowledgment, search/restore, native flush/checkpoint and sync recovery, with bounded maintenance and CPU/event-loop context. Local durability and server acknowledgment remain distinct; retries settle one logical outcome; unknown restored ages stay unknown. Disabled, throwing or overloaded observers cannot govern document contents, access, edit delivery or recovery. The [production emitter inventory](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/blob/f232e21b4910afe6209a22d8d78516c598eba1a5/docs/diagnostics.md) defines units, attribution, timing and omissions.

**Merged:** `8e9dccbd90f04ad79bd12cba3695e5c4ff04e02d` by guarded squash, parent actual main `312e5546386ece21f8e0845d696598cc4d85c731`. **Reviewed source:** `f232e21b4910afe6209a22d8d78516c598eba1a5`. Squash tree `e793569c4a93d2d81cd00dee7922441abc11b9b4` exactly equals both reviewed source and actual tested merge `1f17dee5a50529852b85c28e64c632404028c94c`. **Agent review only.** Both exact-head reviews scored100/100; all four fresh first-attempt hosted workflows passed. Root verified no unresolved review threads/blockers, current base/head and all required checks before merge. Main/origin advanced cleanly to the squash.

## 🧭 Complete L outcome, scope and personas

The original **L** outcome includes integration, authority, persistence, native/platform investigation, operational verification and repair. Its production seams are usable document open; real local checkpoint completion and validated server ACK; search and snapshot restore; connection/reconnect/resync/refresh, pending native-mutation count and oldest age; offline publication/recovery; native flush reason/group/outcome; checkpoint capture/skip/persistence; maintenance drain/phases/verification; and process CPU/event-loop context. A refusal handoff does not claim replacement-editor readiness. No diagnostic timestamp becomes persistent edit authority.

Browser claims remain explicitly frontend observations with server-derived account/session/file/Space/generation authority. Guests do not collect. Fixed content-free schemas exclude names, content, formulas, credentials, arbitrary exception text and raw URLs. Whole operation bundles are sampled across fixed families; bounded queues and rate-pressure discards expose losses without pretending to be a complete census. Deliberate feedback remains SPN-098's separately durable operation; SPN-110's seven-day retention remains unimplemented M work with its recorded feedback/export boundaries. Neither ticket discharges SPN-123 acceptance.

All original native/state safeguards remain: incremental pending accounting, current16-state/200-history policy, all five actual Undo/Redo groups in the70-character lost-ACK case, selection/peer/server-receipt/storage/reopen assertions, constructor-only recovery and Safari opaque-pointer loader checks, whole-browser storage quiescence and account-transition history. The earlier ACK repair retains the terminal refusal handoff while requiring valid receipt chronology before observing success. No native replay authority, new SDK patch, tracing service or persistent analytics queue is introduced.

**Scope reconciliation:** final actual-base diff is **20,502 counted lines across255 paths**, including durable original evidence and documentation. The fixture repair is427 additions/404 deletions largely from wrapping indentation; whitespace-insensitive72/49 totals121 lines versus the early less-than100 substantive-line estimate. This variance is recorded rather than excluded. The coherent L soft-limit disposition remains: production observations, authority/native verification, concrete repairs and honest failures form one acceptance outcome; splitting its required cleanup would leave that outcome incomplete. No limit, workload, deadline, source-selection rule or requirement was relaxed. See the [canonical implementation and decisions](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/blob/f232e21b4910afe6209a22d8d78516c598eba1a5/docs/implementation/SPN-123.md).

Operator gets truthful bounded private evidence without another service. Owner retains document contents/history and independent local/server save meaning. Collaborator retains account-specific readiness, shared-save/peer/access authority and original refusal behavior. Link guest gains no collection or private account/recovery authority and remains immediately revocable. No new visible product design differs from actual main; rendering/interaction and platform acceptance still apply.

## 🔗 Actual-main integration and fixture repair

Tested merge `aaac6083a066c2a9f3f394650834eb33b2a270db` parents reviewed7fd and actual312. Actual312 has parentc1 and tree `90b90d75271c9251ce753c39d5190ad5f9c7058c`, equal to the prospective SPN-120 source reviewed during preparation. Finalf232 adds only documentation/evidence. All **1,405 non-documentation tracked files** match testedaaac. The parent audit verifies **396 nonoverlap paths**, including correct deletions, and root independently inspected the complete substantive fixture diff.

- SPN-098 paired-feedback staging, generation fencing, idempotency, Operator ownership and per-chunk transfer checks remain alongside diagnostic browser allowlists/access checks. The restored `writeFile` import remains. The full feedback and production diagnostic assertions remain; old whole-block hashes are historical because cleanup wrapping changes fixture bytes.
- SPN-090 offline startup/bootstrap/build/install readiness, diagnostic collection admission and evidence-only scoped detached native snapshot hooks remain. Browser-known-offline state cannot establish online diagnostic authority. Existing mock/lifetime cleanup and native snapshot tests remain.
- SPN-120's owned process/readiness/finite audit implementation is retained exactly. Only backlog.json and the generated index conflicted. The diagnostics fixture needed one concrete integration repair: its `finally` could replace the original feature failure when newly bounded process cleanup rejects, and setup could strand resources acquired before fixture return.
- The repair reuses landed `withFixtureCleanup`. Handles are recorded immediately after successful acquisition; startApp owns its own startup rejection cleanup. Member context → database → owned process → temporary directory cleanup attempts each layer and preserves the first failure plus later errors. All five scenarios protect work and cleanup, including page/cookie acquisition; extra collaborator-context and pending-route cleanup cannot prevent fixture cleanup. Operator context remains runner-owned. Original ports3298/3299, security/content/feedback/native assertions and timeouts remain. The ordered173-expression audit normalizes only whitespace/legal trailing argument commas and supplements full diff inspection.
- CLI bookkeeping removes only SPN-123 relative to actual312, records `[SPN-098, SPN-090, SPN-120, SPN-123]`, nextID161, November14 grooming and **23 open tickets**. SPN-156's external phone prerequisite and separate SPN-110/SPN-038 owners remain unchanged.

## ✅ Independent exact-head reviews

Both SAME independent nonimplementing reviewers assessed the complete L outcome on exact **f232e21b4910afe6209a22d8d78516c598eba1a5**, using the complete original specification, full diff, source-bound evidence and grade-free prior findings. Each scored **100/100** with rubric **35/35 scope,25/25 correctness,20/20 meaningful regressions,10/10 delivered workflow/usability,10/10 maintainability/overcomplexity**. Both report no actionable finding or remaining step to100. **Agent review only.** Neither deducted for CI results or treated pending hosted acceptance as passed.

- [Reviewer A complete original report](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/blob/f524dd4d5ddaee80b2553f1be5174d0631bc655f/docs/review-assets/spn-123-review-f232e21b/spn123-review-f232e21b-a.md): independently62/62 fixture controls in5files, first attempt **6,571ms/316,400KiB**, no abort/signal. Independently verified1,405 tested-source bindings and all50 native sample inputs; original source audit/log/receipt retained.
- [Reviewer B complete original report](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/blob/f524dd4d5ddaee80b2553f1be5174d0631bc655f/docs/review-assets/spn-123-review-f232e21b/spn123-review-f232e21b-b.md): independently62/62 fixture controls in5files **6,516ms/287,648KiB**, plus40/40 diagnostic/account/native controls in3files **2,337ms/754,992KiB**, both first attempt with no abort/signal. Independently verified the fixture assertions, actual-parent integration,1,405 bindings and50 sample inputs.

Root fully read both reports and inspected raw outcomes. Prior7fd/c270 reports remain historical; neither an old assessment nor this local review authorizes merge. The linked new review archive is **published and remotely verified** at f524dd4d5ddaee80b2553f1be5174d0631bc655f. Root independently verified all19 Git/payload bindings,1,655 packet TAR members,8 original TAR members and14 exact original report/log/receipt/audit copies before publication.

## 🧪 Current local checks and source-bound reuse

The manager serialized all workloads under pinnedNode26.13.0, normal pressure1, shared serial lock, unchanged2GiB/eight-minute guard and200ms sampling. Dependency donor1.3.1 remained immutable; no installation, relinking or donor cache mutation occurred. Compiler settings remained `GOMEMLIMIT=640MiB`, `GOGC=50`, `GOMAXPROCS=2`.

First runtime attempts on committedaaac passed:

- **62/62 controls in five existing files**,6,638ms,289,056KiB peak: owned child startup/exit, forced/inherited-pipe cleanup, original-plus-cleanup failures, evidence/resource disposal, exact prepared-session identity, single allowlisted retry, HTTP reset/real denial and finite audit ownership/fail-closed controls.
- **Full TypeScript**,9,350ms,1,785,536KiB peak, binding the changed browser consumer to the actual helper API.
- Targeted lint120ms,RSS unsampled; corrected installedPrettier418ms,210,848KiB; CLI index169ms,RSS unsampled. Unsampled does not mean zero memory use.
- Exact-final-f232 backlog/PR/selection policy741ms,270,208KiB:15 suites selected,16 source/shared-dependency cases and60 selected missing/skipped/failed/cancelled results rejected. This is local classifier evidence, not an actual hosted plan or CI result.

Two preparation mistakes are retained in [maintained integration evidence](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/tree/f232e21b4910afe6209a22d8d78516c598eba1a5/docs/implementation/evidence/SPN-123-312-integration): the initial formatter named absentoxfmt and failed MODULE_NOT_FOUND in85ms before formatting, then used installedPrettier; the first assertion audit normalized whitespace only and rejected one legal trailing comma. Its corrected external comparison changed no assertion. Neither is a runtime test failure/resource abort or an excuse for unchanged retries. The root's initial integration reader separately encountered correctly deleted SPN-120; explicit deletion handling then verified all396 parent paths, with both reader versions preserved.

Earlier runs retain original identities:167 implementer contracts and independent173/228 reviews on the prior integration,181 ACK-repair controls, three expected withheld-guard false-success detections,78 SPN-098 integration controls, and earlier native/runtime/SDK/routing verification. They are not new executions onf232. The previous compiler resource abort, original6ef import failure and later changed-source compiler passes remain separate outcomes. No local browser, fullSDK, performance or native-platform matrix was repeated.

**Retained native off/on sample:** all50 source/installed-SDK hashes independently match current files. Its measurement source remains `d51f6375411207b52f80f0072d520b725a150219`; it was not rerun for fixture-only changes. Twelve timed off/on outcomes plus two saturated native outcomes share hash `75237803b6f9bbe5f9bc1e4a1452c5dbafe4eb1e051934249fcf39e4ae49b223`, retaining content/resources/history/saved peers/once-only receipts/revoked-write refusal. Medians **0.666785ms off /0.713622ms on per save**, observed difference **+0.046837ms**; ranges overlap (off0.601965–0.785635,on0.604507–1.445396). The sample originally took1,202ms/337,936KiB. The independent pressure control reconciles500=64 admitted+244 queue+192 transport/cooldown and actual second-batch429; additional saturated-native sampling/queue losses are separate.

This small in-process native/collector sample excludes browser rendering, real network/SQLite/IDB, initial SDK setup, account handshake, later untimed save, separately reported collector flush and feedback-export latency. It is neither a new f232 measurement nor an old/new causal benchmark or explanation for historical pauses. The older ACK sample with49/50 matching inputs remains historical because SPN-098 changed the route.

## 🔧 Independent finding and repair loop

At prior candidate `cae5a58689b049e4f62c3a815482e21bb5212f49`, reviewer A scored **96/100 (35/22/19/10/10)** and reviewer B **94/100 (35/21/18/10/10)**. Both identified the same P2: an already-refused nonpreserving client counted a shape-valid matched but stale ACK as a successful durable save before checking revision consistency. The independent real fixture had only one actual server history row; the second request was never committed. No validation push was authorized while that source blocker remained. Original complete reports and reproduction are preserved unchanged, separately from masked re-review inputs.

The minimal repair checks that the receipt advances the immutable request base and current confirmed revision, and equals `replayBase + 1` when unchanged replay applies. It selects diagnostic success versus cancelled/unknown; it adds no native replay or recovery authority. The existing terminal response still clears the sent request and completes the original refusal handoff. Genuine committed late and duplicate receipts remain truthful and once-only.

Seven real native/server fixture cases cover older/equal-base, above-base but replay-inconsistent receipts, and genuine late/duplicate receipts with and without the replay guard. They assert actual durable history/content, unchanged visible/confirmed snapshots, original refusal and exact event cardinality. With the guard withheld on the exact original source, all three negative cases fail on the false-success event; the repaired source is restored in `finally` and all source/test hashes are retained. This expected negative failure is a detection proof, not a repaired product failure or a passing acceptance run.

Desktop/mobile responsiveness comparisons passed their actual current plan with complete raw input/long-task samples and CPU profiles retained; these do not explain or erase the old 110.4 ms failure. Current main's changes and SPN-160 observations do not establish historical cause or retrospectively repair these outcomes.
- Native **41961921117** failed Safari at nullable JXA loader error-string conversion. The original failing probe and opaque-pointer proof remain. - Original Firefox storage-empty failure retains its exact source/job. The whole-browser quiescence/interleaved-writer fixture demonstrates a mechanism, not certainty about the original writer. Later distinct source results keep their own identities; current native acceptance is still required.
- Original sized-restore/history and reauthentication/navigation failures retain their first records. Source repairs keep actual content/access/readiness and deadlines; navigation collision remained an inference, not an invented exact exception. Main's retained fixtures do not erase those original failures.
- Original install/compiler/browser resource aborts and the reviewer's mistaken Linux-only process-supervisor attempt remain explicit. That unsupported batch was deliberately terminated with owned cleanup; its corrected supported run passed separately. Neither is relabelled as a product pass. No unchanged heavy or unsupported local rerun is justified by these reviews.

A fresh source change permits the coordinated first selected validation. Any new failure must retain its original outcome and receive a concrete source/scope decision; it does not authorize an unchanged rerun, weaker deadline, reduced workload or broader cleanup authority.
